title: Pinyin Input
summary: Offline pinyin input with a compact top candidate strip.
description: Offline Simplified Chinese pinyin input. Starts in English; Ctrl+Space toggles pinyin. A top candidate strip supports arrow navigation, Space/Enter confirmation and numbered selection. Tested with APPLaunch 0.6.111 and its bundled ZClaw and CLI/ST terminal; other app or firmware builds require a matching adapter. Restart APPLaunch after installation. The optional typing-practice field does not accept Sym symbols; Sym input works in the tested terminal.

zh-CN.summary: Ctrl+Space 切换中英文，顶部候选栏，完全离线拼音输入。
zh-CN.description: 默认英文，Ctrl+Space 切换拼音；顶部候选栏支持方向键选词、空格或 Enter 确认、数字直选。已在 APPLaunch 0.6.111 及其内置的 ZClaw、CLI/ST 终端验证，其他应用或固件版本需单独适配。安装后重启启动器。试输入页暂不支持 Sym 符号，已测试的终端可正常输入符号。
